summary: Iteration 334 — frontend-only, both platforms. All P0s VERIFIED PASSING: (1) Mobile onboarding DOB masking now works (typing '01011940' auto-formats to '01/01/1940', partial '15'->'15','1506'->'15/06','15061955'->'15/06/1955'; with valid ISO DOB + all other required fields, onboarding-step1-continue becomes enabled and advances to step 2/authorisation). (2) Aged Care Q&A on web /ai-tools/family-coordinator renders proper markdown (bold text, links, multiple short paragraphs) — no literal '**' or '[text](url)' visible in body text; the 'Report an Issue With This Result' button now sits BELOW the input bar (btnTop≈1032 > inputTop≈946). (3) Letters required-field GATE web: lf1-required-gate + lf1-required-missing + lf1-required-missing-jump present and lf1-generate-button disabled until required fields are filled; missing message correctly lists 'Complaint category'. (4) Letters required-field GATE mobile: lf1-required-missing present with correct wording and lf1-generate-button DISABLED — but lf1-required-gate wrapper testID and lf1-required-missing-jump testID are MISSING on mobile (parity gap; behavior itself works). (6) Auto-address: web+mobile show lf1-recipient-use-provider with 'Address to Test Provider 8c1af9aa / profile@testprovider.com.au / One tap' and tapping updates lf1-recipient-current. Fresh signup on mobile is BLOCKED behind Stripe payment (signup-payment-gate) — could not run onboarding via a brand-new account without a card, so DOB flow was verified against cathy's account via deep-linked step-1 (draft PUT with step:1). rca of the issue: The DOB mobile onboarding blocker root cause was that DateField on the Expo web platform previously rendered a native-style picker Pressable that never produced an ISO date when the user typed. The fix (onWebText in DateField) now digit-masks the TextInput to DD/MM/YYYY and only calls onChange with an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' when all 8 digits form a valid calendar date, unblocking step1Valid which requires /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/ on t1.dob.
